settings.title: Compression settings

recommended.name: Recommended
recommended.text: Much less weight, with no changes visible at a glance.

high.name: High quality
high.text: Differences you cannot see even when zoomed in. Smaller savings.

max.name: Maximum compression
max.text: The smallest weight possible. Changes may show when zoomed in.

custom.name: Custom
custom.text: You set the quality of every image.

settings.outputHint: GIF and SVG files always keep their format.
settings.metaHint: Keeps camera data and the color profile. It weighs a bit more and may include the location.
settings.resizeHint: Only shrinks images larger than the limit. Off by default.
settings.pngNote: PNG files with many colors are reduced to a palette when it does not show. "High quality" loses not a single pixel.

about.title: How Squeezo works
about.lead: Less weight, same dimensions, and nothing leaves your device.

how.title: From folder to zip

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Choose what goes in and what does not.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: One by one or everything in a zip.

how.drag: Drag the files into the box
how.hint: It is a demo: drag the files, check what you want and compress.

items.name: JPG, WebP and AVIF
items.text: Lowers the quality just to the point where the difference stops showing.

items.name: PNG
items.text: Trims the color palette when it does not show. In high quality it keeps every pixel.

items.name: GIF
items.text: Keeps the animation and takes weight out from the inside.

items.name: SVG
items.text: Strips hidden scripts and extra code, and looks just as sharp.

items.name: ZIP
items.text: Opens it in parts, so a huge zip is explored instantly.

items.name: Videos and others
items.text: Left alone: you are told which ones were left out.

steps.title: Read
steps.text: Opens the image in your browser and checks what it really is: its content, its dimensions and its format.

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: Compresses it at several qualities and compares each result with the original, in brightness and in color.

steps.title: Choose
steps.text: Keeps the lightest version that passes the threshold of the chosen level. If none weighs less, it keeps the original.

steps.title: Verify
steps.text: Before handing it over, it measures the result on the full image, not just on a sample.

band.title: A thousand images in a single tab.
band.text: Squeezo splits the work across the cores of your processor and opens zips in parts, without loading them whole into memory. That is why a large zip is explored instantly.

facts.label: to read a zip of 1000 images

items.title: It looks inside the file
items.text: Every file is identified by its content, not by its extension. A .jpg that is really text is rejected.

items.title: Zips that cannot do harm
items.text: Paths that try to escape the folder, password-protected entries and files that inflate far beyond their stated size are rejected.

items.title: SVGs without scripts
items.text: Scripts and external links are removed from SVG files, and they are only shown as images, never as pages.

items.title: No personal data
items.text: JPG and PNG files lose their hidden data, such as the camera model and the location, unless you ask to keep it.

items.a: Not at a glance. Squeezo compares every result with the original and only accepts it if the difference does not show. For maximum fidelity, choose "High quality".
No. Width and height stay the same, unless you turn on the dimension limit in the settings.

items.q: What happens to videos inside a zip?
items.a: They are left out and you are told how many there were. Squeezo only compresses images.
Up to 1000 images per zip and 50 megapixels per image.

items.q: What if I reload the page?
items.a: You pick up where you were. Your progress is saved in the browser, even if a compression was halfway through.

p: Your images, folders and zips are processed in your browser and never uploaded to a server. So you do not lose your progress, they stay in your browser's storage until you press "Clear".
No accounts, no tracking cookies, no analytics and no ads.
Your browser remembers the language, the theme and the compression settings.
When a JPG or a PNG is compressed, hidden data such as the camera or the location is erased unless you choose to keep it. An image that cannot be reduced is returned as it was.
The site is hosted on Vercel, which may log technical data about the visit, such as the IP address. It never includes your images.
Squeezo checks the real content of every file, never runs anything you add, and strips scripts from SVG files.
Squeezo is free. Use it only with images you have the right to use.
They remain yours. Squeezo never modifies your originals: it creates copies that you download separately.
Squeezo aims for the difference not to show, but no lossy compression guarantees an identical result. Always keep your originals.
Up to 1000 images per zip. Anything that is not an image, or looks dangerous, is left out.
